Your privacy is our priority.

differences_from_rkeon_bot: Single product (Eyecojic Under Eye Gel), so no category slot or product cards.
Opens with a yes/no skin-tone image-upload gate; the key feature is photo-based recommendation (needs image analysis, which an intent/slot bot alone cannot do).
Main menu: About Us, Product, Buy, Contact Us (no Directors, Track Order or Feedback).
Buy and info replies are text plus links to eyecojic.com pages.
